checks: Approach updates through two/one/zero stops; focus enters prompt and Tab stays inside
Open prompt follows missing/stale/empty/recovered and farther-away evidence; one notification only; Escape returns to Done
Restored prompt dismissal has a persistent focus target; external focus is preserved
Failed feed expires, recovery retains one-shot behavior, mobile/reflow controls fit, final destination survives Done
Done/Dismiss/replan/automatic end maintain focus without stealing surviving external focus
Initial missing/stale/empty snapshots do not instruct getting off; recovery prompts; touch dismissal and Map-to-Trip finish paths exercised
